name: Photo AI
one_liner: Train on your face, generate pro AI headshots & photos.
revenue_range: ~$80–132K/mo peak (founder: monthly revenue, not pure MRR)
notes: Passed $100K/mo Aug 2024; later posts cited ~$132K then lower. Solo PHP app.
one_liner_zh: 用自己的脸训练，生成专业 AI 证件照与写真。
notes_zh: 2024 年 8 月突破月入 $100K；后续帖文提到约 $132K 后又回落。个人 PHP 应用。

name: Interior AI
one_liner: AI interior design & virtual staging from a room photo.
notes: Founder cited ~$45K MRR with >99% margins; later public counters ~$21–23K.
one_liner_zh: 上传房间照片，AI 室内设计与虚拟软装。
notes_zh: 创始人曾称约 $45K MRR、毛利 >99%；后来公开计数约 $21–23K。

name: Chatbase
one_liner: Custom AI chatbots / agents trained on your data for customer support.
notes: Bootstrapped; hit $1M ARR in months; founder later posted $8M ARR crossed.
one_liner_zh: 基于你的数据训练定制 AI 客服聊天机器人 / Agent。
notes_zh: 自力更生；数月内达 $1M ARR；创始人后来称已突破 $8M ARR。

name: Jenni AI
one_liner: AI academic writing assistant with grounded citations.
notes: Often called Jenny AI; ~$10M ARR with a small team; profitable after small angel round.
one_liner_zh: 带可靠引用的 AI 学术写作助手。
notes_zh: 常被称作 Jenny AI；小团队约 $10M ARR；小额天使轮后已盈利。

name: Magai
one_liner: One subscription for 50+ AI models, personas, and team workspaces.
notes: $1M lifetime sales in 32 months; Indie Hackers echoed nearly $100K MRR.
one_liner_zh: 一个订阅打通 50+ AI 模型、人设与团队工作区。
notes_zh: 32 个月累计销售额 $1M；Indie Hackers 称接近 $100K MRR。

name: Neural Frames
one_liner: Text-to-video for musicians — AI music videos in minutes.
revenue_range: ~$100K in one month (revenue, not pure MRR; high GPU costs)
notes: Also styled NeuroFrames; founder said ~$100K prior-month revenue with ~1,500 paying customers.
one_liner_zh: 面向音乐人的文生视频——几分钟出 AI 音乐视频。
notes_zh: 亦写作 NeuroFrames；创始人称上月营收约 $100K，约 1,500 付费用户。

name: Arvow
one_liner: AI SEO content platform for agencies (ex-Journalist AI).
notes: Grew largely via YouTube tutorials within ~1 year.
one_liner_zh: 面向代理商的 AI SEO 内容平台（前身 Journalist AI）。
notes_zh: 约一年内主要通过 YouTube 教程增长。

name: Leadmore AI
one_liner: AI Reddit marketing: find subreddits, post safely, track leads.
notes: Founder claimed $1M ARR; some reports note run-rate style math vs classic subscription ARR.
one_liner_zh: AI Reddit 营销：找子版、安全发帖、追踪线索。
notes_zh: 创始人称 $1M ARR；有报道指更像年化跑速而非经典订阅 ARR。

name: MindPal
one_liner: No-code multi-agent AI workflows for business automation.
notes: ~$500K ARR in under two years via customer-led pivots from a weekend MVP.
one_liner_zh: 无代码多智能体工作流，用于业务自动化。
notes_zh: 不到两年约 $500K ARR；从周末 MVP 起靠客户反馈迭代转型。

name: FormulaBot
one_liner: Plain-language → Excel/Sheets formulas & spreadsheet AI analysis.
notes: Classic AI-wrapper spreadsheet tool; peak MRR often cited at ~$40K.
one_liner_zh: 自然语言 → Excel/Sheets 公式与表格 AI 分析。
notes_zh: 典型 AI wrapper 表格工具；峰值 MRR 常被引为约 $40K。

name: ReplyGuy
one_liner: AI auto-replies that mention your product on Reddit & Twitter.
notes: Reached ~$10K MRR then sold for undisclosed six figures (~1 year).
one_liner_zh: 在 Reddit / Twitter 自动回复并提及你的产品。
notes_zh: 达到约 $10K MRR 后以未披露六位数金额出售（约 1 年）。

name: Kolbo.AI
one_liner: All-in-one creative AI workspace (100+ image/video/music models).
notes: Stripe-verified MRR vs higher trailing-30d due to annual prepay/credits.
one_liner_zh: 一站式创意 AI 工作区（100+ 图/视频/音乐模型）。
notes_zh: Stripe 验证 MRR 低于近 30 日收入，因年付预付/积分所致。

name: Swan AI
one_liner: AI GTM engineer — agentic sales/marketing pipelines.
notes: Reported ~$1M ARR in ~9 weeks with 3 founders; later raised $6M.
one_liner_zh: AI GTM 工程师——代理式销售/营销流水线。
notes_zh: 约 9 周、3 名创始人做到约 $1M ARR；后融资 $6M。

name: Gamma
one_liner: AI-native presentations, docs, and websites (PowerPoint alternative).
notes: Ceiling case: VC-backed, $100M+ ARR, ~$2.1B valuation (founder/press).
one_liner_zh: AI 原生演示文稿、文档与网站（PPT 替代）。
notes_zh: 规模上限案例：VC 支持，$100M+ ARR，估值约 $2.1B（创始人/媒体）。

name: TypingMind
one_liner: Polished multi-model chat UI + team LLM frontend (BYOK).
revenue_range: $1M trailing-12-mo revenue (mix of one-time + Team subs)
notes: Founder PnL: $1M in last 12 months; ~50% still one-off licenses.
one_liner_zh: 精致的多模型聊天界面 + 团队 LLM 前端（自带 Key）。
notes_zh: 创始人损益：近 12 个月 $1M；约半数仍是一次性授权。

name: Midjourney
one_liner: Bootstrapped AI image generation via Discord (then web).
notes: No VC; widely reported ~$200M revenue. Higher $300–500M figures are estimates.
one_liner_zh: 自力更生的 AI 生图，经 Discord（后上 Web）。
notes_zh: 无 VC；广泛报道约 $2 亿营收。更高的 $3–5 亿多为估算。

name: Inbox Zero
one_liner: Open-source AI email assistant for Gmail/Outlook triage & drafts.
notes: Open-source + paid; grew via PH, HN, SEO, referrals.
one_liner_zh: 开源 AI 邮件助手，用于 Gmail/Outlook 分拣与草稿。
notes_zh: 开源 + 付费；靠 Product Hunt、HN、SEO、推荐增长。

name: SiteGPT
one_liner: ChatGPT for your website — train a bot on your site content.
notes: Founder year-end update: grew from ~$8.3K to ~$15.8K MRR in 2025.
one_liner_zh: 网站版 ChatGPT——用站点内容训练机器人。
notes_zh: 创始人年终更新：2025 年 MRR 从约 $8.3K 增至约 $15.8K。

name: Setter AI
one_liner: AI appointment setting — text follow-up that books calendar slots.
notes: Pivoted from unreliable voice AI to WhatsApp/SMS text follow-up.
one_liner_zh: AI 预约设定——短信跟进并锁定日历档期。
notes_zh: 从不稳定的语音 AI 转型 WhatsApp/短信文字跟进。

name: HeadshotPro
one_liner: AI professional headshots from selfies (one-time purchase).
revenue_range: Widely cited peak ~$300K/mo sales (one-time; figure debated)
notes: SEO-led AI headshot business; $300K/mo is profiled as peak monthly sales, not verified MRR.
one_liner_zh: 自拍生成专业证件照（一次性购买）。
notes_zh: SEO 驱动的 AI 证件照业务；$300K/月被描述为峰值月销售额，非经核实 MRR。
